summary.en: Yusuke Kawashima held an audition the previous day where whoever passed would get to co-star with Miyuki Jono. Just some hours ago, someone got inside and murdered him, then got away on their motorcycle and nearly hit a café maid on their run. Assistant film director Akito Kubodera ran into the culprit when they rushed out of Kawashima's room; he found their appearance identical to Haruko Nagisa, one of the auditors. Kubodera’s testimony was strengthened via security camera footage collected by the police and testimony from nearby civilians. Unfortunately, he was the only one to see the culprit’s face since they wore a motorcycle helmet on their run. Reckless endangerment Consequence: Hit by a motorcycle The culprit nearly hit the café maid on their way to escape the scene.
